area.title: Shooting range usage
area.text: Overview of all authorised shooting ranges with traffic-light status for quota compliance and noise exposure. From here to shot counts, details and simulation.

data.title: Data management
data.text: Master data of the shooting ranges, weapon assignment and categories, import and export of calculations, users and permissions, MGDM export.

reports.title: Reports
reports.text: Year-on-year comparisons, noise exposure trend and quota utilisation across all authorised ranges.

welcome.title: Welcome to SLIM
welcome.lead: For every military shooting range, SLIM shows how much was fired and whether the noise limits at the surrounding buildings are met.
welcome.explore: Explore an example range, check usage data and compare noise assessments.
welcome.prototype: This demo runs on prepared example data. Some areas, such as data management, are still placeholders.
welcome.disclaimer: The results are for illustration only and are not technically approved assessments.
